name: VTEP down WITH a coincident link-down on the source interface: a link fault dragging the VTEP — prefer local-link-fault
comment: P3 discriminator: a VTEP going unreachable WITH a concurrent link_state_change is a symptom of the link fault. The vtep-unreachable discriminator fires (link_state_change present) and defers to sig.ent.access.local-link-fault, which fully covers (link + interface anomaly on the same port) and wins.
